caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object, possibly a decorated bag or envelope, shown in an open, unfolded state oriented vertically on an off-white background. The object features two identical geometric designs, one on the upper half and one on the lower half, each composed of red, green, black, and white colors. These designs consist of horizontal rectangular sections filled with parallel black lines, alternating with rows of red triangles or zigzag patterns bordered in white triangles on a black background. At the edges of the rectangles, green stepped or triangular shapes are accented with thin black outlines. Multiple vertical red and green lines resembling tassels or fringe extend from the top and bottom of the designs, each ending in small black dots or shapes. The background of the rectangular object itself is beige with irregular brown and grey areas, suggesting an aged or worn surface. A small black line and hook-like shape appears at the fold between the two halves. The artist's name “ANN BENE BIGKLEY” is inscribed in small capitals in the lower right corner on the background.
title: Book Cover
